senses.gloss: परीष्ट m. an elder brother antecedently to whom the younger performs a S˚ s˚, ib.
परीष्ट See परि-यज्, p. 599.
प॑रि-शक्तवे inf. of परि-√ शक्, to overpower, to conquer, RV.

परि-√ शङ्क् Ā. -शङ्कते (inf. -शङ्कितुम्), to suspect, doubt, distrust (acc.), MBh.; R. &c.;
to believe, fancy to be (2 acc.), ib.
परि-शङ्कनीय mfn. to be doubted or distrusted or feared or apprehended (n. impers. ‘distrust must be felt’), Kāv.; Pur.
परि-शङ्का f. suspicion, distrust, Jātakam.
hope, expectation, R.
परि-शङ्कित mfn. suspicious, distrustful, afraid of (abl. or comp.), MBh.; R.; Pur.
suspected, questionable, MBh.
believed, expected (अ-परिश्˚), MBh.
thought to be, taken for (nom.), Gīt.
परि-शङ्किन् mfn. fearing, apprehending, Ragh.
afraid on account of (comp.), BhP.
परि-शठ mfn. thoroughly dishonest or wicked, Car.
परि-शन्न mfn. (√ शद्) fallen away or by the side, ĀśvŚr.
परि-षन्न (!) mfn. lost or omitted, AV.Pariś.

परि-√ शप् P. Ā. -शपति, ˚ते, to curse, execrate, TāṇḍBr.;
to abuse, revile (aor. पर्य्-अशाप्सीत्), Bhaṭṭ.
परि-शप्त n. cursing, reviling, anathema, TāṇḍBr.
परि-शाप m. id., W.
परि-शब्दित mfn. (√ शब्द्) mentioned, communicated, MBh.
परि-शमित mfn. (√ शम्, Caus.) allayed, quenched, destroyed, Gīt.
परि-शायन See परि-शी.
परि-शायन n. causing to lie completely in, complete immersion, Baudh.
परि-शाश्वत mfn. continuing for ever, perpetually the same, MBh.
परि-शिञ्जित mfn. (√ शिञ्ज्) made to hum or resound from all sides, MBh.
परि-शिथिल mfn. very loose or lax, Jātakam.
प॑रि-शिष्ट (प॑रि-), mfn. left, remaining, TS.; &c.
प॑रि-शिष्ट n. a supplement, appendix (N. of a class of works supplementary to Sūtras)
परि-शिष्ट—कदम्ब m. n. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—पर्याय m. pl. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—पर्वन् n. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रकाशस्य-सार-मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रबोध m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—सिद्धान्त-रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—सूत्र-पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
परि-शेष mfn. left over, remaining, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Var.
परि-शेष m. n. remnant, remains, rest, MBh.; Var.
परि-शेष m. supplement, sequel, MBh.
termination, conclusion, L.
परी—शेष m. rest, remainder, AitBr. (cf. परि-श्˚).
परि-शेषेण ind. completely, in full
परि-शेषात् ind. consequently, therefore, Śaṃk.
परि-शेष—खण्ड m. or n. N. of wk.
परि-शेष—वत् mfn. having a supplement or appendix, Cat.
परि-शेष—शास्त्र n. a supplementary work, L.
परि—शेषण n. remainder, residue, BhP.
परि-शेषित mfn. left over, remaining from (comp.), BhP.
परि-√ शी Ā. -शेते (impf. 3. pl. अशेरन्; 2. du. -अशायतम्; 3. sg. -अशायत), to lie round or near or in, surround, remain lying, RV.; TS.; ŚBr.

परि-√ शील् P. -शीलयति, to practise, use frequently, Kāv.;
to treat well, cherish, Prasann.
परि-शीलन n. touch, contact (lit. and fig.), intercourse with, application or attachment to, pursuit of (comp.), constant occupation, study, Kāv.; Sāh.
परि-शीलित mfn. practised, used, employed, pursued, studied, Kāv.
inhabited, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 52, Sch.
परि-शुद्ध mfn. cleaned, purified, pure
cleared off, paid
acquitted, discharged, MBh.; Kāv.; Pur.
(ifc.) diminished by, that from which a part has been taken away, MBh.
परि-शुद्धि f. complete purification or justification, acquittal (˚धिं-√ कृ, to prove one's innocence), Ragh.; Bālar.; Kathās.
rightness, correctness, Kāraṇḍ.
परि-शोध m. = next, W.
परि-शोधन n. cleaning, purification, Uttarar.
discharging, paying off, Kull.

परि-√ शुभ् (शुम्भ्) P. -शु॑म्भति, to prepare, AV.;
 Ā. -शोभते, to shine, be bright or beautiful, MBh.
परि-शोभित mfn. adorned or beautified by (instr. or comp.), Hariv.; R.
परि-शोभित—काया f. N. of an Apsaras and a Gandharvī, Kāraṇḍ.
परि-शुश्रूषा See परि-श्रु.
परि-शुश्रूषा f. complete or implicit obedience, Śukas.

परि-√ शुष् P. Ā. -शुष्यति, ˚ते, to be thoroughly dried up, to shrivel, wither (lit. and fig.), pine, waste away, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -शोषयति (Pass. -शोष्यते), to dry up, emaciate, Kāv.; Pañc.; Suśr.
परि-शुष्क mfn. thoroughly dried or parched up, withered, shrivelled, shrunk (as a vein), hollow (as the cheeks) &c., MBh.; Kāv.; Var.; Suśr.
परि-शुष्क n. (with मांस) meat fried in ghee dried and spiced, L.
परि-शुष्क—तालु mfn. having the palate dried up, Ṛt.
परि-शुष्क—पलाश mfn. having withered foliage, R.
परि-शोष m. complete dryness, desiccation, evaporation (˚षं-√ गम्, to become dry or thin), R.; Suśr.
परि-शोषण mfn. drying up, parching, MBh. (v.l. ˚षिन्)
परि-शोषण n. drying, parching, emaciating, MBh.
परि-शोषित mfn. dried up, parched, Cat.
परि-शोषिन् mfn. becoming dry or withered, shrivelling, Rājat.
v.l. for ˚शोषण, MBh.
परि-शून्य mfn. quite empty, (ifc.) totally free from or devoid of Ragh.
परि-शृत m. or n. (√ श्रा ?) ardent spirits, liquor, L. (cf. परि-स्रुत्, -स्रुता under परि-स्रु).
परि-सृत mfn. having roamed or wandered through (acc.), R.
spread everywhere, ib.
परि-सृत m. or n. an enclosed or fenced place, MBh.
परि-√ शॄ Pass. -शीर्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to be cleft or rent asunder, to be split, MBh.

परि-√ श्रम् (only ind.p. -श्रम्य), to fatigue or exert one's self, R. :
Caus. -श्रमयति, to fatigue, tire, Naiṣ.
परि-श्रम m. fatigue, exertion, labour, fatiguing occupation, trouble, pain, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-श्राम m. fatiguing, occupation, trouble, BhP.
परि-श्र˚मापह mfn. relieving weariness, MW.
परि-श्रमण mfn. (?) free from fatigue or weariness, BhP., Sch.
परि-श्रान्त mfn. thoroughly fatigued or worn out, (ifc.) tired of, disgusted with, Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-श्रान्ति f. fatigue, exhaustion
labour, trouble, W.

परि-√ श्रि P. -श्रयति (ind.p. -श्रित्य; Ved. inf. प॑रि-श्रयितवै॑),
to surround, encircle, fence, enclose, TS.; Br.; ŚrS. :
Pass. -श्रीयस्व, be surrounded or surround thyself, VS. xxxvii, 13.
परि-श्रय m. an enclosure, fence (in स॑-परिश्˚), ŚBr.
a refuge, asylum, Pañc. (B.), i, 252
an assembly, meeting, L.
N. of a prince, VP.
परि-श्रयण n. encompassing, surrounding with a fence, KātyŚr., Sch.
परि-श्रि॑त् f. pl. ‘enclosers’, N. of certain small stones laid round the hearth and other parts of an altar, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (ifc. ˚श्रित्क).
परि-श्रित mfn. standing round, MBh.
surrounded by (instr. or comp.), Kathās.; BhP.
w.r. for ˚श्रुत, MBh.
प॑रि-श्रित (प॑रि-) n. = प॑रि-वृत n. (see under परि- √ 1. वृ), TS.; Br.; ŚrGṛS.
परि-√ श्रु P. -शृणोति (ind.p. -श्रुत्य), to hear, learn, understand, R.
परि-श्रुत mfn. heard, learnt, MBh.; R.; Hariv.
known as, passing for (nom.), ib.
famous, celebrated, MBh.; BhP.
w.r. for प्रति-श्˚, MBh.
परि-श्रुत m. N. of an attendant of Skanda, ib.
परि-स्रुत mfn. flowed or streamed round, trickled, oozed, R.; Kathās.
परि-स्रुता f. = ˚स्रुत् f., L.
परि-स्रु॑त् mfn. flowing round or over, foaming, fermenting, RV.
परि-स्रु॑त् f. a kind of intoxicating liquor prepared from herbs, AV.; VS.; ŚBr. (˚स्रु॑न्-मत् mfn. possessing it, ŚBr.)
dropping, flowing, W.
परि-श्लथ mfn. quite loose or relaxed, Vcar.
परि-श्लिष्ट mfn. (√ श्लिष्) clasped, embraced, W.
परि-श्लेष m. an embrace, ib.
परि-षण्ड m. or n. a partic. part of a house, L.
परि-षण्डा f. a valley (?), Divyāv., (v.l. ˚खण्ड).
परि-षण्ड—वारिक m. a servant, ib.
परि-ष॑द् mfn. surrounding, besetting, RV.
परि-ष॑द् f. an assembly, meeting, group, circle, audience, council, ŚBr.; Kauś.; Mn. (˚षत्-त्व n., xii, 114), MBh. &c.
N. of a village in the north g. पलद्य्-आदि
परि-षत्-त्व n., xii, 114
परि-षद्-वल mfn. surrounded by a council (as a king), Pāṇ. v, 2, 112, Sch.
forming or containing assemblies, Bhaṭṭ.
परि-षद्—वल m. a member of an assembly, assessor, spectator, L.
परि-षद v.l. for पारि-षद, पार्षद.
पारि—षद mf(ई)n. (-षद्) fit for an assembly, decent, Car.
relating to a village परिषद्, g. पलद्य्-आदि
पारि—षद m. a member of an assembly, assessor at a council, auditor, spectator, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (R. [B.] also -षद्) pl. the retinue or attendants of a god, MBh.; BhP.
पारि—षद n. taking part in an assembly, BhP.
परि-ष॑द्य mfn. to be sought after, RV. vii, 4, 7 (Nir. ‘to be avoided’, Sāy. ‘sufficient, adequate, competent’)
to be worshipped, VS. v, 32 (Mahīdh. ‘belonging to an assembly’)
परि-ष॑द्य m. a member of an assembly, spectator, guest, L.
पारि—षद्य m. a member of an assembly, spectator, councillor, Rājat.; Divyāv. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 4, 44; 101).
परि-ष॑द्वन् mfn. surrounding, besetting, RV.
परि-षय See परि-षो.
परि-षय m.

परि-षह् (√ सह्) Ā. -षहते (impf. पर्य्-अषहत or -असहत; fut. परि-सोढा [Vop. -षहिता]; inf. -सोढुम्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 70 &c.; aor. पर्य्-असहिष्ट, Bhaṭṭ.),
to sustain, bear up against (acc.) :
Caus. aor. पर्य्-असीषहत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 116.
परि-षहा f. forbearance, patience, W. (cf. परी-ष्˚).
परी—षहा f. = परि-ष्˚ (under परि-षह्), HYog.

परि-षिच् (√ सिच्) P. -षिञ्चति (impf. पर्य्-अषिञ्चत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; ind.p. -सिञ्चित्वा [!], SaddhP.; Pass. pr. p. -षिच्यमान, R.),
to pour out or in (esp. from one vessel into another),
to pour or scatter about, sprinkle, diffuse, RV. :
Caus. -षेचयति, or -षिञ्चयति to sprinkle, MBh.;
to soak, macerate, Suśr. :
Desid. -षिषिक्षति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 64, Sch.
प॑रि-षिक्त (प॑रि-), mfn. poured out, sprinkled about, diffused, RV.; Lāṭy.; Śiś.
परि-षेक m. sprinkling over, moistening, Suśr.
a bath, bathing apparatus, ib.; MBh.; Var. (cf. परी-ष्˚).
परी—षेक m. = परि-ष्˚ (under परि-षिच्), Suśr.
परि-षेचक mfn. pouring over, sprinkling (comp.), g. याजकादि (v.l. ˚वेषक, Kāś.)
परि-षेचन n. pouring over, sprinkling, ŚrS.; Var.; Suśr.
water for watering trees, MBh.

परि-षिध् (√ सिध्) P. -षेधति (impf. पर्य्-अषेधत्), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; 65, Sch.:
Desid. -षिषेधयिषति, 64, Sch. (cf. परि-सिध्).
परि-√ सिध् Caus. -सेधयति, to drive about (cows), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 113, Kāś. (cf. परि-षिध्).

परि-षिव् (√ सिव्) P. -षीव्यति (impf. पर्य्-अषीव्यत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 70), to sew round, wind round, KātyŚr.:
Caus. aor. पर्य्-असीषिवत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 116.
परि-षीवण n. sewing round, winding round, KātyŚr.
परि-√ 3. षु P. -षुणोति, (impf. पर्य्-अषुणोत् fut. परि-सोष्यति), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 &c. Sch.

परि-षू (√ 1. सू) P. -षुवति (impf. पर्य्-अषुवत्), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; 65, Sch.;
 -षौति, to grasp, bunch together (?), ĀpŚr.
परि-षवण n. grasping, bunching together, ib.
परि-षूत॑ mfn. urged impelled to come forth, elicited (sc. by the gods, said of young grass), TS.
प॑रि-षूति (प॑रि-), f. urging from all sides, beleaguering, oppression, vexation, RV.
परि-षेण m. (प्˚ + सेना) N. of a man (see पारिषेण्य).

परि-षेणय Nom. P. ˚यति, (prob.) to surround with an army, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65, Sch.:
Desid. ˚षिषेणयिषति, 64 Sch.
परि-षेव् (√ सेव्) Ā. -षेवते (impf. पर्य्-अषेवत; pf. परि-षिषेव, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 &c.; but there occurs also -सेवते &c.), to frequent, practise, pursue, enjoy, honour, Kāv.; Pur.; Pañc.
परि-षो (√ सो) P. -ष्यति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65, Sch.
परि-षित mfn., ib. 70.
परि-षोडश mfn. pl. full sixteen, MBh.

परि-ष्कन्द् (√ स्कन्द्) P. -ष्कन्दति, or -स्कन्दति (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 74), to leap or spring about, Bhaṭṭ. :
Intens. -चनिष्कदत् id., RV. viii, 58, 9.
परि-√ स्कन्द् See परि-ष्कन्द्.

परि-ष्कण्ण (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 74) or परि-स्कन्न (MBh.), mfn. spilled, scattered
 m. = or w.r. for next, L.

परि-ष्कण्ण (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 74) or परि-स्कन्न (MBh.), mfn. spilled, scattered
 m. = or w.r. for next, L.
1. परि-ष्कन्द॑ (or ˚स्कन्द) m. (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 75, Sch.) a servant (esp. one running by the side of a carriage), VS.; AV.; MBh. &c.
a foster-child, one nourished by a stranger, W.
2. परि-ष्कन्द m. a temple, Gaut. xix, 14 (v.l. ˚ष्कन्ध).

परि-ष्-√ कृ (ष् for स् inserted, or perhaps original in a √ स्कृ = √ 1. कृ cf. उप-स्कृ and सं-स्-कृ) P. -कृणोति (3. pl. -कृण्व॑न्ति, RV. ix, 14, 2; 64, 23; p. -कृण्व॑त्, ib. 39, 2; impf. पर्य्-अष्करोत्, or -अस्करोत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 70; 71), to adorn, fit out, prepare, make ready or perfect, RV. (cf. परि-कृ and Pāṇ. vi, 1, 137),
परि-ष्-कर m. ornament, decoration, MBh. viii, 1477 (according to Nīlak. = 1. ˚ष्कन्द).
परि-ष्-कार m. = prec. (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh. &c.
cooking, dressing, W.
domestic utensils, furniture, SaddhP.
purification, initiation, ib.
self-discipline, Lalit. (one of the ten powers of a Bodhisattva, Dharmas. lxxiv)
परि-ष्-कार—चीवर n. a kind of garment, L.
प॑रि-ष्-कृत (प॑रि-), mfn. prepared, adorned, embellished, furnished with, surrounded or accompanied by (instr. or comp.), RV. &c. &c.
cooked, dressed, W.
purified, initiated, ib.
परि-ष्कृति f. finishing, polishing, W.
(in rhet.) a partic. figure of speech = परि-कर (see under परि-कृ), Cat.
परि-ष्-क्रिया f. adorning, decorating, MārkP.
v.l. for परि-क्रिया in अग्नि-प्˚, q.v.
परि-ष्टम्भ् (√ स्तम्भ्) P. -ष्टभ्नोति or -ष्टभ्नाति (Caus. aor. पर्य्-अस्तम्भत्), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 67; 116, Sch.
परि-ष्टि f. (√ 1. अस्; cf. अभि-ष्टि, उप-स्ति) obstruction, impediment, distress, dilemma, RV.
परीष्टि f. investigation, research, inquiry, Jaim.; Pat.
service, attendance, homage, L.
freedom of will, L.
परि-ष्टु (√ स्तु) P. -ष्टौति (impf. पर्य्-अष्टौत्, or -अस्तौत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 70), to praise, Kām.
परि-ष्टवन n. praise, L.
परि-ष्टवनीय mfn. intended for a praise (as a hymn), ŚāṅkhŚr.
परि-ष्टुत mfn. praised, sung, ib.
प॑रि-ष्टुति (प॑रि-), f. praise, celebration, RV.
परि-ष्टोम m. = परिस्तोम, L.
परि-ष्टुभ् (√ स्तुभ्) P. -ष्टोभति (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; 65), to cry or exult on every side, RV.; TāṇḍBr.
परि-ष्टु॑भ् mfn. exulting on every side, RV.
परि-ष्टोभ m. embellishing a Sāman with Stobhas (s.v.), TāṇḍBr.
परि-ष्ठल n. (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 96) surrounding place or site, W.
परि-ष्ठा॑ mfn. obstructing, hindering
परि-ष्ठा॑ f. obstruction, impediment, RV.; AV.
परि-ष्ठिति f.
परि-स्थान (!) n. abode, residence, fixedness, firmness, MW.
परि-स्यन्द ˚दन &c. See परिष्यन्द, p. 603, col. 2.
परि-ष्यन्दन or परि-स्यन्दन, n. dropping, oozing, W.
परि-ष्यन्दन or परि-स्यन्दन, n. dropping, oozing, W.
परि-ष्यन्दिन् or परि-स्यन्दिन्, mfn. flowing, streaming, L.
परि-ष्यन्दिन् or परि-स्यन्दिन्, mfn. flowing, streaming, L.
